title: Clean review firewall
description: Objective: implement the clean independent-review surface as a trust boundary that cannot receive or render worker transcript, self-assessment, handoff persuasion, or dead-end journal. Deliverable: apps/control-room/src/attempts/review-surface.tsx and review-surface.test.tsx, containing exactly cr.review.diff, criteria, receipts, findings, and graph/plan context inside cr.review.surface, with exact base/head provenance and honest missing-proof handling. NOT in scope: attempt detail, transcript/journal props, review command submission, evidence rerun, fetching, routing/mounting, authoritative response schemas, or edits outside the two files. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/attempts/review-surface.test.tsx.
definitionOfDone: Focused DOM tests assert cr.review.surface contains the five required descendants and contains zero cr.inspector.transcript.*, journal, self-assessment, or handoff-persuasion elements.
Diff rendering requires separately supplied exact base and head SHAs; missing either produces UNKNOWN and no diff-success presentation, while out-of-scope changed paths are visibly flagged.
Criteria, receipts, findings, graph/plan hashes, reviewer identity/eligibility, and calibration are rendered as supplied truth; absent eligibility/calibration/evidence stays UNKNOWN with provenance.
review-surface.tsx exposes no transcript/journal/self-assessment prop, both files are <=250 physical lines, and the exact focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: The clean-review exclusion boundary is non-waivable: never add transcript, journal, self-assessment, or persuasive handoff data to its props or DOM.
Do not infer reviewer eligibility, acceptance, or evidence strength; render only supplied daemon truth and exact design outcome vocabulary.
Own and stage only apps/control-room/src/attempts/review-surface.tsx and review-surface.test.tsx.
